hook.text: A 1,000-person conference generates 530 tons of CO2, thousands of plastic items, and hundreds of kilos of food waste.

buildup.text: Sustainable event practices include digital badges, reusable signage, local catering, carbon offsets.

discovery.text: ISO 20121 certifies sustainable event management. The London 2012 Olympics was the first event to achieve full certification.

twist.text: Many 'sustainable' events simply buy carbon offsets without reducing actual emissions.

climax.text: Attendees increasingly demand sustainable events. 73% of millennials say they'd pay more for sustainably managed conferences.

punchline.text: 530 tons of CO2 per conference. Sustainable events aren't optional anymore.

quiz.question: What was the first event to achieve full ISO 20121 sustainability certification?
